lines.text: It’s project time! Write rules that make art: use nested loops to build patterns from shapes, controlled randomness so every run is different, and explain your rules in an artist statement.
Generative artists write rules, and the computer makes the art.
Randomness means every run is different.
A loop inside a loop: the inner loop draws a shape, the outer loop repeats it with a turn to make a rosette.
Use pick random for colour, position or size — but keep some rules fixed so it still looks designed.
Real generative artists explain their rules.
Write which rules you chose and why.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
